name: Job Matching Automation with Visual Analytics

parameters.text:
=You are a resume data extraction engine.

Your ONLY task is to extract factual information from the provided resume.

IMPORTANT RULES:

* Do NOT write a summary.
* Do NOT explain your answer.
* Do NOT use Markdown.
* Do NOT add comments.
* Do NOT invent or infer information.
* If information is unavailable, return an empty string or empty array.
* Extract skills only when they are explicitly present in the resume.
* Normalize obvious variations such as:

  * "Structured Query Language" → "SQL"
  * "Power BI Desktop" → "Power BI"
  * "MS Excel" → "Excel"
* Keep experience level based on explicit evidence in the resume.
* A student with no professional employment experience should generally be represented as "Fresher", unless the resume explicitly demonstrates otherwise.

Extract the following information:

* Candidate name
* Email
* Phone
* Location
* Target job roles
* Technical skills
* Soft skills
* Programming languages
* Data/analytics tools
* Years of professional experience
* Experience level
* Education
* Certifications
* Preferred job type
* Preferred locations

OUTPUT FORMAT: Return ONLY a single valid JSON object (no code fences) with exactly these keys:
candidate_name, email, phone, location, target_job_roles (array), technical_skills (array), soft_skills (array), programming_languages (array), data_analytics_tools (array), years_of_experience, experience_level, education (array), certifications (array), preferred_job_type, preferred_locations (array).

Resume text:

{{ $json.text }}

parameters.customBody: ={{ (() => { let p = $json.output || {}; if (!p || typeof p !== 'object') { try { p = JSON.parse(String($json.text || '').replace(/\u0060\u0060\u0060json|\u0060\u0060\u0060/g, '').trim()); } catch (e) { p = {}; } } const roles = (Array.isArray(p.target_job_roles) ? p.target_job_roles : []).map(x => String(x).trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,3); const locs = (Array.isArray(p.preferred_locations) ? p.preferred_locations : []).map(x => String(x).trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,3); if (!locs.length && p.location) locs.push(String(p.location).trim()); if (!roles.length) roles.push('Data Analyst'); if (!locs.length) locs.push('India'); const urls = []; for (const role of roles) for (const loc of locs) urls.push('https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/search/?keywords=' + encodeURIComponent(role) + '&location=' + encodeURIComponent(loc)); return JSON.stringify({ urls: urls.slice(0,9), limitPerSource: 10, autoConvertToAiSearch: true, scrapeCompany: false }); })() }}

parameters.pythonCode:
# =====================================================================
#  CALCULATE JOB MATCH
#  n8n Code node  |  Language: Python  |  Mode: Run Once for All Items
#
#  Deterministic, explainable resume-to-job matching. NO imports.
#  Input : one item per normalized job. Each item carries `resume`
#          (the parsed resume object) attached by the "Attach Resume" node.
#  Output: one item per job (score, breakdown, matched/missing skills, summary)
# =====================================================================

ENGINE_VERSION = "1.1.1"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. CONFIGURATION  (edit here, nothing else needs to change)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
WEIGHTS = {
    "skills": 40,
    "experience": 20,
    "job_title": 15,
    "location": 10,
    "job_type": 5,
    "education": 10,
}  # must add up to 100

# Percentage (0-100) given when the data needed to judge a dimension is missing.
NEUTRAL = {
    "skills_unknown": 50,           # no skills detectable in the job
    "experience_unspecified": 80,   # job states no experience requirement (not punished)
    "title_no_target": 50,          # resume has no target roles
    "location_unknown": 50,         # job or resume location missing
    "job_type_no_pref": 80,         # resume has no job-type preference
    "job_type_unknown": 60,         # job has no job type
    "education_unspecified": 80,    # job states no degree requirement
    "education_candidate_unknown": 50,  # job wants a degree, resume education unreadable
}

# If True: MySQL/PostgreSQL imply SQL, Pandas/NumPy/... imply Python, PySpark implies Spark
APPLY_IMPLIED_SKILLS = True

CANDIDATE_SKILL_FIELDS = [
    "technical_skills", "programming_languages", "analytics_tools",
    "tools", "databases", "skills", "technical_tools", "software_tools",
    "technologies", "tech_stack",
]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. CONTROLLED SKILL VOCABULARY  (canonical name -> alias phrases)
#    Extend by adding a new key or appending aliases.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
SKILL_VOCAB = {
    "python": ["python", "python programming", "python3", "python 3"],
    "sql": ["sql", "structured query language", "t sql", "tsql", "pl sql", "plsql",
            "sql queries", "sql programming"],
    "r": ["r programming", "r language", "rstudio", "r studio"],  # bare "R" handled separately
    "excel": ["excel", "ms excel", "microsoft excel", "advanced excel"],
    "power bi": ["power bi", "powerbi", "microsoft power bi", "ms power bi",
                 "power bi desktop", "power bi service"],
    "tableau": ["tableau", "tableau desktop", "tableau public"],
    "looker": ["looker", "looker studio", "google data studio", "data studio"],
    "qlik": ["qlik", "qlikview", "qlik sense"],
    "pandas": ["pandas"],
    "numpy": ["numpy"],
    "matplotlib": ["matplotlib"],
    "seaborn": ["seaborn"],
    "scikit-learn": ["scikit learn", "sklearn"],
    "tensorflow": ["tensorflow"],
    "pytorch": ["pytorch"],
    "postgresql": ["postgresql", "postgres", "postgre sql"],
    "mysql": ["mysql", "my sql"],
    "sql server": ["sql server", "ms sql", "mssql", "microsoft sql server"],
    "mongodb": ["mongodb", "mongo db", "mongo"],
    "snowflake": ["snowflake"],
    "bigquery": ["bigquery", "big query"],
    "databricks": ["databricks"],
    "aws": ["aws", "amazon web services"],
    "azure": ["azure", "microsoft azure"],
    "gcp": ["gcp", "google cloud", "google cloud platform"],
    "spark": ["spark", "apache spark"],
    "pyspark": ["pyspark"],
    "hadoop": ["hadoop"],
    "airflow": ["airflow", "apache airflow"],
    "dbt": ["dbt"],
    "etl": ["etl", "extract transform load"],
    "dax": ["dax"],
    "power query": ["power query"],
    "vba": ["vba"],
    "google sheets": ["google sheets"],
    "git": ["git"],
    "github": ["github"],
    "jupyter": ["jupyter", "jupyter notebook"],
    "machine learning": ["machine learning", "ml"],
    "deep learning": ["deep learning"],
    "nlp": ["nlp", "natural language processing"],
    "statistics": ["statistics", "statistical analysis", "statistical modeling",
                   "statistical modelling", "statistical"],
    "data visualization": ["data visualization", "data visualisation", "data viz"],
    "data modeling": ["data modeling", "data modelling"],
    "data warehousing": ["data warehousing", "data warehouse", "data warehouses"],
    "a/b testing": ["a b testing", "ab testing", "a b tests"],
    "sas": ["sas"],
    "java": ["java"],
    "javascript": ["javascript"],
}

IMPLIED_SKILLS = {
    "pandas": ["python"], "numpy": ["python"], "matplotlib": ["python"],
    "seaborn": ["python"], "scikit-learn": ["python"],
    "tensorflow": ["python"], "pytorch": ["python"],
    "mysql": ["sql"], "postgresql": ["sql"], "sql server": ["sql"],
    "pyspark": ["spark", "python"],
}

DISPLAY_NAMES = {
    "sql": "SQL", "aws": "AWS", "gcp": "GCP", "etl": "ETL", "dax": "DAX",
    "nlp": "NLP", "sas": "SAS", "r": "R", "vba": "VBA", "dbt": "dbt",
    "power bi": "Power BI", "mysql": "MySQL", "postgresql": "PostgreSQL",
    "mongodb": "MongoDB", "pyspark": "PySpark", "numpy": "NumPy",
    "github": "GitHub", "bigquery": "BigQuery", "sql server": "SQL Server",
    "scikit-learn": "Scikit-learn", "a/b testing": "A/B Testing",
    "javascript": "JavaScript", "tensorflow": "TensorFlow", "pytorch": "PyTorch",
    "databricks": "Databricks", "qlik": "Qlik",
}

# Experience level text (LinkedIn "seniority") -> (min_years, max_years); first match wins
EXP_LEVEL_MAP = [
    ("mid senior", 3, None), ("senior", 5, None), ("director", 8, None),
    ("executive", 8, None), ("internship", 0, 1), ("intern", 0, 1),
    ("entry", 0, 1), ("fresher", 0, 1), ("trainee", 0, 1), ("graduate", 0, 1),
    ("junior", 0, 2), ("associate", 0, 2),
]
TITLE_LEVEL_MAP = [
    ("senior", 5, None), ("sr", 5, None), ("lead", 5, None), ("principal", 6, None),
    ("head", 8, None), ("director", 8, None), ("junior", 0, 2), ("jr", 0, 2),
    ("intern", 0, 1), ("internship", 0, 1), ("trainee", 0, 1), ("fresher", 0, 1),
    ("graduate", 0, 1),
]

# Title matching
SENIORITY_UP = ["senior", "sr", "lead", "principal", "staff", "head", "director",
                "manager", "vp", "chief"]
SENIORITY_DOWN = ["junior", "jr", "intern", "internship", "trainee", "associate",
                  "fresher", "graduate", "entry", "level"]
ROLE_TYPE_WORDS = ["analyst", "engineer", "scientist", "developer", "specialist",
                   "consultant", "executive", "officer", "architect"]
TITLE_FILLER = ["and", "of", "the", "for", "a", "an", "in", "at", "to", "with", "i", "ii", "iii"]
TITLE_SYNONYMS = {"analytics": "analyst", "analysis": "analyst", "analysts": "analyst",
                  "jr": "junior", "sr": "senior", "engineers": "engineer",
                  "scientists": "scientist", "developers": "developer"}

# Location
COUNTRIES = ["india", "united states", "usa", "united kingdom", "uk", "canada",
             "germany", "singapore", "uae", "united arab emirates", "australia"]
CITY_SYNONYMS = {"bengaluru": "bangalore", "bombay": "mumbai", "gurugram": "gurgaon",
                 "new delhi": "delhi", "madras": "chennai", "calcutta": "kolkata"}
LOC_FILLER = ["greater", "area", "metropolitan", "region", "district", "urban"]

# Job type
JOB_TYPE_ALIASES = [
    ("internship", ["internship", "intern"]),
    ("part-time", ["part time", "parttime"]),
    ("full-time", ["full time", "fulltime", "permanent"]),
    ("contract", ["contract", "contractor", "temporary", "freelance"]),
]

# Education
CAND_EDU_LEVELS = [
    (4, ["phd", "ph d", "doctorate", "doctoral"]),
    (3, ["master", "masters", "m tech", "mtech", "m sc", "msc", "mba", "mca",
         "m e", "m s", "pgdm", "post graduate", "postgraduate"]),
    (2, ["bachelor", "bachelors", "b tech", "btech", "b e", "b sc", "bsc", "b com",
         "bcom", "bca", "bba", "undergraduate"]),
    (1, ["diploma", "associate degree"]),
]
JOB_EDU_LEVELS = [
    (4, ["phd", "ph d", "doctorate", "doctoral"]),
    (3, ["master", "masters", "mba", "m tech", "mtech", "msc", "m sc",
         "postgraduate", "post graduate"]),
    (2, ["bachelor", "bachelors", "b tech", "btech", "bsc", "b sc", "undergraduate"]),
    (1, ["diploma"]),
]
EDU_LEVEL_NAMES = {0: "unknown", 1: "diploma", 2: "bachelor's", 3: "master's", 4: "PhD"}
JOB_EDU_FIELDS = ["computer science", "information technology", "data science",
                  "statistics", "mathematics", "engineering", "analytics",
                  "artificial intelligence", "business", "economics", "finance",
                  "information systems", "operations research", "computer applications"]
CAND_DATA_RELATED = ["computer", "information technology", "data", "statistic",
                     "mathematic", "artificial intelligence", "machine learning",
                     "analytic", "engineering", "software", "information system",
                     "economics", "business"]
PREFERRED_WORDS = [" preferred ", " plus ", " advantage ", " desirable ",
                   " good to have ", " nice to have ", " a bonus "]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. SMALL HELPERS (no imports)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
def plain(x):
    """Convert n8n/Pyodide proxy objects to normal Python if needed."""
    # The native Python runner already passes plain dicts/lists, and
    # hasattr() is not available in its sandbox, so no conversion is needed.
    return x


def sval(x):
    x = plain(x)
    if x is None:
        return ""
    return str(x).strip()


def clean(s):
    """lowercase; keep letters/digits/+/#; everything else -> single space."""
    s = sval(s).lower()
    out = []
    for ch in s:
        if ch.isalnum() or ch in "+#":
            out.append(ch)
        else:
            out.append(" ")
    return " ".join("".join(out).split())


def clean_text(v):
    """Light cleanup used by the new extractors: str, trimmed, single spaces.
    (Unlike clean(), it keeps '.', '-' and '+', so '2.5 years' and '3+ years' survive.)"""
    return " ".join(sval(v).split())


def padded(s):
    return " " + clean(s) + " "


def flatten_text(x):
    x = plain(x)
    if x is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(x, (list, tuple)):
        return " ; ".join([flatten_text(i) for i in x])
    if isinstance(x, dict):
        return " ; ".join([flatten_text(v) for v in x.values()])
    return str(x)


def as_list(v):
    v = plain(v)
    if v is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(v, (list, tuple)):
        out = []
        for i in v:
            i = plain(i)
            if i is None:
                continue
            if isinstance(i, (list, tuple, dict)):
                out.append(flatten_text(i))
            else:
                out.append(str(i))
        return [s.strip() for s in out if s and s.strip()]
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        return [flatten_text(v)]
    s = str(v).replace(";", ",")
    return [p.strip() for p in s.split(",") if p.strip()]


def to_number(v):
    v = plain(v)
    if v is None or isinstance(v, bool):
        return None
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
        return float(v)
    num = ""
    started = False
    for ch in str(v):
        if ch.isdigit():
            num += ch
            started = True
        elif ch == "." and started and "." not in num:
            num += ch
        elif started:
            break
    try:
        return float(num) if num not in ("", ".") else None
    except Exception:
        return None


def clamp(x, lo=0.0, hi=100.0):
    return max(lo, min(hi, x))


def pretty(s):
    if s in DISPLAY_NAMES:
        return DISPLAY_NAMES[s]
    return " ".join([w.capitalize() for w in str(s).split(" ")])


def uniq(seq):
    out = []
    for s in seq:
        if s not in out:
            out.append(s)
    return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. SKILL NORMALIZATION & EXTRACTION
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
SKILL_PHRASES = []
for _canon in SKILL_VOCAB:
    _aliases = [clean(a) for a in SKILL_VOCAB[_canon]]
    if _canon != "r":                      # bare "r" would match "R&D" -> handled separately
        _aliases.append(clean(_canon))
    _aliases = uniq(_aliases)
    SKILL_PHRASES.append((_canon, [a for a in _aliases if a]))


def has_standalone_r(raw):
    """True if the language 'R' appears as its own item (not R&D, not 'R' inside a word)."""
    t = sval(raw)
    for sep in [",", ";", "/", "|", "\u2022", "\u00b7", "(", ")", "\n", "\r", ":", "*",
                " and ", " or "]:
        t = t.replace(sep, "\n")
    for line in t.split("\n"):
        if line.strip(" .-\u2013\u2014\u2022\t") == "R":
            return True
    return False


def canon_skills(raw):
    """Map one free-text skill ('Microsoft Power BI Desktop') to canonical vocab names."""
    c = clean(raw)
    if not c:
        return []
    p = " " + c + " "
    found = []
    for canon, aliases in SKILL_PHRASES:
        for a in aliases:
            if (" " + a + " ") in p:
                found.append(canon)
                break
    if c == "r" and "r" not in found:
        found.append("r")
    return found


def detect_vocab_in_text(text):
    """Find vocabulary skills in free text, ordered by first appearance."""
    p = padded(text)
    hits = []
    for canon, aliases in SKILL_PHRASES:
        best = -1
        for a in aliases:
            idx = p.find(" " + a + " ")
            if idx != -1 and (best == -1 or idx < best):
                best = idx
        if best != -1:
            hits.append((best, canon))
    if has_standalone_r(text):
        hits.append((len(p), "r"))
    hits.sort(key=lambda h: h[0])
    return [h[1] for h in hits]


def normalize_skill_name(value):
    raw = sval(value).lower().strip()
    s = clean(value)          # lowercase, punctuation -> space ("ms-excel" -> "ms excel")

    replacements = {
        "microsoft sql": "sql",
        "ms sql": "sql",
        "mssql": "sql",
        "sql server": "sql",
        "mysql": "mysql",
        "postgres": "postgresql",
        "postgres sql": "postgresql",
        "postgre sql": "postgresql",
        "powerbi": "power bi",
        "power bi desktop": "power bi",
        "ms power bi": "power bi",
        "microsoft power bi": "power bi",
        "tableau desktop": "tableau",
        "ms excel": "excel",
        "microsoft excel": "excel",
        "google sheets": "google sheets",
        "scikit learn": "scikit-learn",
        "sklearn": "scikit-learn",
        "machine-learning": "machine learning",
        "data visualization": "data visualization",
        "data visualisation": "data visualization",
    }

    if s in replacements:
        return replacements[s]
    if raw in SKILL_VOCAB:    # already canonical, e.g. "a/b testing" (clean() would break the slash)
        return raw
    return s


def add_implied_skills(skills):
    result = list(skills)
    if not APPLY_IMPLIED_SKILLS:
        return result
    for skill in list(result):
        for implied_skill in IMPLIED_SKILLS.get(skill, []):
            if implied_skill not in result:
                result.append(implied_skill)
    return result


# ================================================================
# ROBUST CANDIDATE SKILL EXTRACTION
# ================================================================
def extract_candidate_skills(resume):
    found = []

    if not isinstance(resume, dict):
        return []

    for field in CANDIDATE_SKILL_FIELDS:
        value = resume.get(field)
        # iterate the raw list so dict items like {"name": "Python"} survive
        items = value if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)) else as_list(value)

        for raw in items:
            if isinstance(raw, dict):
                raw = (
                    raw.get("name")
                    or raw.get("skill")
                    or raw.get("technology")
                    or raw.get("tool")
                    or raw.get("value")
                    or ""
                )

            text = clean_text(raw)

            if not text:
                continue

            canonical = canon_skills(text)

            if canonical:
                found.extend(canonical)
            else:
                # controlled-vocabulary detection inside longer phrases
                detected = detect_vocab_in_text(text)

                if detected:
                    found.extend(detected)
                else:
                    found.append(normalize_skill_name(text))

    # Remove duplicates while preserving order
    result = []
    seen = set()

    for skill in found:
        s = normalize_skill_name(skill)

        if not s:
            continue

        if s not in seen:
            seen.add(s)
            result.append(s)

    return add_implied_skills(result)


def job_required_skills(job):
    req = []
    for entry in as_list(job.get("skills")):
        found = canon_skills(entry)
        if not found:
            c = clean(entry)
            if c and len(c.split()) <= 3 and len(c) <= 30:
                found = [c]
        for f in found:
            if f not in req:
                req.append(f)
    text = sval(job.get("job_title")) + ". " + sval(job.get("description"))
    for f in detect_vocab_in_text(text):
        if f not in req:
            req.append(f)
    return req


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. EXPERIENCE
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# ================================================================
# FALLBACK SKILL SCAN - used only when the listed skill fields give nothing
#   1. look inside ANY field whose name hints at skills (core_competencies, key_skills, ...)
#   2. else scan the whole resume text
# Fallback keeps controlled-vocabulary skills only (no free-text phrases are invented).
# ================================================================
SKILL_KEY_HINTS = ["skill", "tool", "tech", "language", "competenc", "software",
                   "database", "framework", "librar", "platform", "stack"]


def text_leaves(v):
    """All text values inside any nested dict/list."""
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        return [x for k in v for x in text_leaves(v[k])]
    if isinstance(v, (list, tuple)):
        return [x for i in v for x in text_leaves(i)]
    if v is None or isinstance(v, (bool, int, float)):
        return []
    t = sval(v)
    return [t] if t else []


def hinted_leaves(v):
    out = []
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        for k in v:
            if any(h in clean(k) for h in SKILL_KEY_HINTS):
                out += text_leaves(v[k])
            else:
                out += hinted_leaves(v[k])
    elif isinstance(v, (list, tuple)):
        for i in v:
            out += hinted_leaves(i)
    return out


def vocab_from_leaves(leaves):
    found = []
    for t in leaves:
        for sk in canon_skills(t) + detect_vocab_in_text(t):
            n = normalize_skill_name(sk)
            if n and n not in found:
                found.append(n)
    return add_implied_skills(found)


def fallback_candidate_skills(resume):
    found = vocab_from_leaves(hinted_leaves(resume))
    if found:
        return found, "key_scan"
    found = vocab_from_leaves(text_leaves(resume))
    if found:
        return found, "full_text_scan"
    return [], "none"


# ================================================================
# ROBUST CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE EXTRACTION   (unknown is NOT zero)
# ================================================================
def parse_year_value(value):
    if value is None or isinstance(value, bool):
        return None

    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return float(value) if value >= 0 else None

    s = clean_text(value).lower()

    if not s:
        return None

    if "fresher" in s or "no experience" in s:
        return 0.0

    # "2 years", "2.5 years", "3+ years", "0-1 years" -> largest number wins.
    # "1 year 6 months" -> 1.5 (numbers followed by 'month' are months, not years).
    years = []
    months = 0.0
    current = ""

    for i, ch in enumerate(s + " "):
        if ch.isdigit() or ch == ".":
            current += ch
        elif current:
            try:
                n = float(current.strip("."))
            except Exception:
                n = None
            if n is not None:
                if s[i:].strip().startswith("month"):
                    months += n
                else:
                    years.append(n)
            current = ""

    if years:
        return round(max(years) + months / 12.0, 2)
    if months:
        return round(months / 12.0, 2)
    return None


def extract_candidate_experience(resume):
    if not isinstance(resume, dict):
        return None

    fields = [
        "experience_years",
        "years_of_experience",
        "total_experience_years",
        "professional_experience_years",
    ]

    for field in fields:
        parsed = parse_year_value(resume.get(field))

        if parsed is not None:
            return parsed

    # experience_level only when it is explicitly meaningful
    level = clean_text(resume.get("experience_level")).lower()

    if level:
        if "fresher" in level or "entry" in level:
            return 0.0

        if "senior" in level:
            return None

    return None


def exp_tokens(text):
    s = sval(text).lower().replace("\u2013", "-").replace("\u2014", "-")
    s = s.replace("+year", "+ year")
    out = []
    for ch in s:
        out.append(ch if (ch.isalnum() or ch in "+-") else " ")
    return "".join(out).split()


def parse_year_mentions(text):
    """Finds '3+ years', '2-4 years', '1 to 2 years' near the word 'experience'."""
    toks = exp_tokens(text)
    found = []
    for i in range(1, len(toks)):
        if toks[i] not in ("year", "years", "yr", "yrs"):
            continue
        window = toks[max(0, i - 6): i + 7]
        if not ("experience" in window or "exp" in window or "experienced" in window):
            continue
        prev = toks[i - 1]
        lo = None
        hi = None
        if prev.endswith("+") and prev[:-1].isdigit():
            lo = int(prev[:-1])
        elif "-" in prev:
            parts = prev.split("-")
            if len(parts) == 2 and parts[0].isdigit() and parts[1].isdigit():
                lo = int(parts[0])
                hi = int(parts[1])
        elif prev.isdigit():
            lo = int(prev)
            if i >= 3 and toks[i - 2] in ("to", "-") and toks[i - 3].isdigit():
                lo = int(toks[i - 3])
                hi = int(prev)
        if lo is not None:
            found.append((lo, hi))
    return found


def map_level(text, table):
    p = padded(text)
    for phrase, lo, hi in table:
        if (" " + phrase + " ") in p:
            return lo, hi
    return None


def job_experience_requirement(job):
    """Returns (min_years, max_years, source). Priority: description years > fresher words > level > title."""
    desc = sval(job.get("description"))
    mentions = parse_year_mentions(desc)
    if mentions:
        best = mentions[0]
        for m in mentions:
            if m[0] > best[0]:
                best = m
        return best[0], best[1], "description"
    pd = padded(desc)
    for w in [" fresher ", " freshers ", " entry level ", " recent graduate ", " recent graduates "]:
        if w in pd:
            return 0, 1, "description"
    lv = map_level(job.get("experience_level"), EXP_LEVEL_MAP)
    if lv is not None:
        return lv[0], lv[1], "experience_level"
    tl = map_level(job.get("job_title"), TITLE_LEVEL_MAP)
    if tl is not None:
        return tl[0], tl[1], "title"
    return None, None, "none"


def experience_pct(c, rmin, rmax):
    if rmin is None:
        return float(NEUTRAL["experience_unspecified"])
    if c >= rmin:
        if rmax is not None and c > rmax + 2:
            return 85.0                      # overqualified, mild penalty
        if rmax is not None and rmin > 0 and c < rmax:
            return 80.0                      # inside a range but below its top
        return 100.0
    gap = rmin - c
    if gap <= 1:
        return 60.0
    if gap <= 2:
        return 35.0
    if gap <= 3:
        return 15.0
    return 0.0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. JOB TITLE / ROLE
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
def title_tokens(s):
    c = " " + clean(s) + " "
    c = c.replace(" business intelligence ", " bi ")
    toks = [t for t in c.split() if t not in TITLE_FILLER]
    return [TITLE_SYNONYMS.get(t, t) for t in toks]


def core_tokens(toks):
    return uniq([t for t in toks if t not in SENIORITY_UP and t not in SENIORITY_DOWN])


def title_pct_single(target, job_title, cand_years):
    tt = title_tokens(target)
    jt = title_tokens(job_title)
    tcore = core_tokens(tt)
    jcore = core_tokens(jt)
    if not tcore or not jcore:
        return 0.0
    if tt == jt:
        return 100.0
    inter = [t for t in tcore if t in jcore]
    coverage = len(inter) / float(len(tcore))
    precision = len(inter) / float(len(jcore))
    score = 100.0 * (0.6 * coverage + 0.4 * precision)
    t_dom = [t for t in tcore if t not in ROLE_TYPE_WORDS]
    j_dom = [t for t in jcore if t not in ROLE_TYPE_WORDS]
    if t_dom and not [t for t in t_dom if t in j_dom]:
        score = min(score, 35.0)             # same role type, different domain
    if score >= 95.0:
        score = 95.0                         # same core role, different qualifiers
    up = [t for t in jt if t in SENIORITY_UP]
    down = [t for t in jt if t in ["junior", "jr", "intern", "internship", "trainee", "fresher"]]
    if up and cand_years is not None and cand_years < 3:
        score -= 30.0
    if down and cand_years is not None and cand_years >= 5:
        score -= 15.0
    return clamp(score)


def title_pct(targets, job_title, cand_years):
    best = 0.0
    for t in targets:
        s = title_pct_single(t, job_title, cand_years)
        if s > best:
            best = s
    return best

# 7. LOCATION
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
def loc_norm(s):
    c = " " + clean(s) + " "
    for a in CITY_SYNONYMS:
        c = c.replace(" " + a + " ", " " + CITY_SYNONYMS[a] + " ")
    toks = [t for t in c.split() if t not in LOC_FILLER]
    return " " + " ".join(toks) + " "


def split_places(values):
    out = []
    for v in values:
        t = sval(v)
        for sep in ["/", "|", ";"]:
            t = t.replace(sep, ",")
        for part in t.split(","):
            n = loc_norm(part).strip()
            if n and n not in out:
                out.append(n)
    return out


def job_is_remote(job):
    text = padded(sval(job.get("location")) + " " + sval(job.get("job_title")))
    if " remote " in text:
        return True
    d = padded(job.get("description"))
    for w in [" fully remote ", " work from home ", " 100 remote ", " remote position ", " remote role "]:
        if w in d:
            return True
    return False


def location_score(prefs, job):
    jl = sval(job.get("location"))
    if not jl or not prefs:
        return float(NEUTRAL["location_unknown"]), "unknown"
    jn = loc_norm(jl)
    remote = job_is_remote(job)
    best = 0.0
    label = "mismatch"
    for p in prefs:
        cand = 0.0
        lab = ""
        if p == "remote":
            if remote:
                cand, lab = 100.0, "remote_match"
        elif p in COUNTRIES:
            if jn.strip() == p:
                cand, lab = 100.0, "country_match"
            elif (" " + p + " ") in jn:
                cand, lab = 60.0, "country_level_match"
        else:
            if (" " + p + " ") in jn:
                cand, lab = 100.0, "city_match"
            elif jn.strip() in COUNTRIES:
                cand, lab = 40.0, "country_only_job_location"
        if cand > best:
            best, label = cand, lab
    if best == 0.0 and remote:
        best, label = 70.0, "remote_available"
    return best, label

# 8. JOB TYPE
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
def canon_job_types(text):
    p = padded(text)
    out = []
    for canon, aliases in JOB_TYPE_ALIASES:
        for a in aliases:
            if (" " + a + " ") in p:
                out.append(canon)
                break
    return out


def job_type_score(cand_types, job):
    jt = canon_job_types(job.get("job_type"))
    if not jt:
        jt = canon_job_types(job.get("job_title"))   # e.g. "Data Analyst Intern"
        jt = [t for t in jt if t == "internship"]
    if not cand_types:
        return float(NEUTRAL["job_type_no_pref"]), "no_preference"
    if not jt:
        return float(NEUTRAL["job_type_unknown"]), "unknown"
    for t in jt:
        if t in cand_types:
            return 100.0, "match"
    return 20.0, "mismatch"

# 9. EDUCATION
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
def find_levels(p, table):
    found = []
    for lvl, phrases in table:
        for ph in phrases:
            needle = " " + ph + " "
            idx = p.find(needle)
            while idx != -1:
                if not (ph == "master" and p[idx: idx + 13] == " master data "):
                    found.append((lvl, idx, ph))
                idx = p.find(needle, idx + 1)
    return found


def is_preferred(p, idx, ph):
    start = idx + len(ph) + 2
    after = p[start: start + 40] + " "
    for w in PREFERRED_WORDS:
        if w in after:
            return True
    return False


def candidate_education_level(edu_text):
    p = padded(edu_text)
    levels = [f[0] for f in find_levels(p, CAND_EDU_LEVELS)]
    return max(levels) if levels else 0


def job_education_requirement(job):
    p = padded(job.get("description"))
    found = find_levels(p, JOB_EDU_LEVELS)
    required = [f[0] for f in found if not is_preferred(p, f[1], f[2])]
    req_level = min(required) if required else None
    anchors = [f[1] for f in found]
    idx = p.find(" degree ")
    while idx != -1:
        anchors.append(idx)
        idx = p.find(" degree ", idx + 1)
    if req_level is None and not found and (" degree in " in p):
        req_level = 2
    fields = []
    for a in anchors:
        seg = p[a: a + 160]
        for f in JOB_EDU_FIELDS:
            if (" " + f + " ") in seg and f not in fields:
                fields.append(f)
    if req_level is None:
        fields = []
    return req_level, fields


def education_score(edu_text, job):
    req_level, fields = job_education_requirement(job)
    cand_level = candidate_education_level(edu_text)
    cand_clean = clean(edu_text)
    detail = {
        "candidate_level": EDU_LEVEL_NAMES.get(cand_level, "unknown"),
        "required_level": EDU_LEVEL_NAMES.get(req_level, "not specified") if req_level else "not specified",
        "required_fields": fields,
    }
    if req_level is None:
        return float(NEUTRAL["education_unspecified"]), "not_specified", detail
    if cand_level == 0:
        return float(NEUTRAL["education_candidate_unknown"]), "unknown", detail
    if cand_level >= req_level:
        level_pct = 100.0
    elif req_level - cand_level == 1:
        level_pct = 40.0
    else:
        level_pct = 20.0
    if not fields:
        field_pct = 100.0
    else:
        hit = False
        for f in fields:
            if f in cand_clean:
                hit = True
            for w in f.split(" "):
                if w not in ("science", "engineering", "systems", "technology", "information") and w in cand_clean:
                    hit = True
        if hit:
            field_pct = 100.0
        else:
            related = False
            for r in CAND_DATA_RELATED:
                if r in cand_clean:
                    related = True
            field_pct = 80.0 if related else 40.0
    pct = 0.7 * level_pct + 0.3 * field_pct
    if cand_level < req_level:
        label = "gap"
    elif pct >= 85.0:
        label = "meets"
    else:
        label = "partial"
    return pct, label, detail


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. SUMMARY (deterministic text built from the numbers)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
def build_summary(r):
    pos = []
    gaps = []
    sk = r["skills"]
    n_req = len(sk["required"])
    n_m = len(sk["matched"])
    if n_req == 0:
        pos.append("no explicit skills listed to compare")
    else:
        p = sk["match_percentage"]
        if p >= 75:
            pos.append("strong skills match (" + str(n_m) + "/" + str(n_req) + ")")
        elif p >= 50:
            pos.append("moderate skills match (" + str(n_m) + "/" + str(n_req) + ")")
        else:
            pos.append("limited skills match (" + str(n_m) + "/" + str(n_req) + ")")
        if sk["missing"]:
            shown = sk["missing"][:3]
            extra = len(sk["missing"]) - len(shown)
            txt = "missing " + ", ".join(shown)
            if extra > 0:
                txt += " +" + str(extra) + " more"
            gaps.append(txt)
    tp = r["match_percentages"]["job_title"]
    if tp >= 80:
        pos.append("close role alignment")
    elif tp >= 50:
        pos.append("partial role alignment")
    elif r["job_title"]:
        gaps.append("role differs from your target roles")
    ll = r["location_match"]
    if ll in ("city_match", "country_match", "remote_match"):
        pos.append("good location alignment")
    elif ll in ("country_level_match", "remote_available", "country_only_job_location"):
        pos.append("acceptable location fit")
    elif ll == "mismatch":
        gaps.append("location differs (" + (r["location"] or "n/a") + ")")
    ex = r["experience"]
    if ex["required_years"] is not None:
        if r["match_percentages"]["experience"] >= 80:
            pos.append("experience requirement met")
        elif r["match_percentages"]["experience"] < 60:
            req = str(int(ex["required_years"])) + "+"
            if ex["candidate_years"] is None:
                gaps.append("asks for " + req + " years experience (your experience was not found on the resume)")
            else:
                gaps.append("asks for " + req + " years experience (candidate has "
                            + str(int(ex["candidate_years"])) + ")")
    if r["education_match"] == "gap":
        gaps.append("education requirement above current degree")
    if r["job_type_match"] == "mismatch":
        gaps.append("job type differs from preference")
    head = ", ".join(pos[:3])
    if len(pos) > 3:
        head += ", " + ", ".join(pos[3:])
    head = head[:1].upper() + head[1:] if head else "Match calculated"
    tail = ("Gaps: " + "; ".join(gaps) + ".") if gaps else "No major gaps identified."
    return head + ". " + tail


def tier(score):
    if score >= 80:
        return "Excellent"
    if score >= 65:
        return "Good"
    if score >= 50:
        return "Fair"
    return "Low"

def build_profile(resume):
    r = resume if isinstance(resume, dict) else {}

    skills = extract_candidate_skills(r)
    skill_source = "listed_fields"
    if not skills:
        skills, skill_source = fallback_candidate_skills(r)

    targets = []
    for value in as_list(r.get("target_job_roles")):
        text = clean_text(value)
        if text:
            targets.append(text)

    preferred_locations = []
    for value in as_list(r.get("preferred_locations")):
        text = clean_text(value)
        if text:
            preferred_locations.append(text)

    if not preferred_locations:
        location = clean_text(r.get("location"))
        if location:
            preferred_locations.append(location)

    preferred_job_types = []
    for value in as_list(r.get("preferred_job_type")):
        text = clean_text(value)
        if text:
            preferred_job_types.append(text)

    experience_years = extract_candidate_experience(r)

    return {
        "available": bool(r),
        "name": sval(r.get("candidate_name")),
        "skills": skills,
        "targets": targets,
        "locations": preferred_locations,
        # the scorers below need these normalized forms:
        "places": split_places(preferred_locations),
        "job_types": uniq([t for v in preferred_job_types for t in canon_job_types(v)]),
        "edu_text": flatten_text(r.get("education")) + " ; " + flatten_text(r.get("certifications")),
        "experience_years": experience_years,
        "experience_known": experience_years is not None,
        "skill_source": skill_source,
        "resume_keys": [str(k) for k in r.keys()],
    }

# 12. SCORE ONE JOB
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
def score_job(job, P):
    title = sval(job.get("job_title"))
    desc = sval(job.get("description"))

    # skills
    candidate_skill_set = set(
        normalize_skill_name(s)
        for s in P.get("skills", [])
        if clean_text(s)
    )

    required = [
        normalize_skill_name(s)
        for s in job_required_skills(job)
        if clean_text(s)
    ]
    required = list(dict.fromkeys(required))          # remove duplicates, keep order

    matched = [s for s in required if s in candidate_skill_set]
    missing = [s for s in required if s not in candidate_skill_set]
    if required:
        skills_pct = round(100.0 * len(matched) / len(required), 1)
    else:
        skills_pct = float(NEUTRAL["skills_unknown"])

    # experience
    rmin, rmax, rsrc = job_experience_requirement(job)
    candidate_years = P.get("experience_years")
    if candidate_years is None:
        exp_pct = 50.0                    # unknown experience is NOT zero experience
    else:
        exp_pct = experience_pct(candidate_years, rmin, rmax)

    # title
    if P["targets"]:
        t_pct = title_pct(P["targets"], title, candidate_years)
    else:
        t_pct = float(NEUTRAL["title_no_target"])

    # location / job type / education
    loc_pct, loc_label = location_score(P["places"], job)
    jt_pct, jt_label = job_type_score(P["job_types"], job)
    edu_pct, edu_label, edu_detail = education_score(P["edu_text"], job)

    pcts = {
        "skills": round(skills_pct, 1),
        "experience": round(exp_pct, 1),
        "job_title": round(t_pct, 1),
        "location": round(loc_pct, 1),
        "job_type": round(jt_pct, 1),
        "education": round(edu_pct, 1),
    }
    breakdown = {}
    total = 0.0
    for k in WEIGHTS:
        breakdown[k] = round(pcts[k] * WEIGHTS[k] / 100.0, 1)
        total += breakdown[k]
    score = round(clamp(total), 1)

    dq = dict(plain(job.get("data_quality")) or {}) if isinstance(plain(job.get("data_quality")), dict) else {}
    dq.update({
        "resume_available": P["available"],
        "candidate_years_assumed": not P["experience_known"],
        "candidate_experience_known": P["experience_known"],
        "skills_detectable": len(required) > 0,
        "experience_requirement_detected": rmin is not None,
        "education_requirement_detected": edu_label != "not_specified",
        "description_available": len(desc) > 0,
        "location_available": len(sval(job.get("location"))) > 0,
        "target_roles_available": len(P["targets"]) > 0,
        "job_type_available": len(sval(job.get("job_type"))) > 0,
    })

    result = {
        "job_id": sval(job.get("job_id")),
        "job_title": title,
        "company": sval(job.get("company")),
        "location": sval(job.get("location")),
        "job_type": sval(job.get("job_type")),
        "experience_level": sval(job.get("experience_level")),
        "posted_date": sval(job.get("posted_date")),
        "job_url": sval(job.get("job_url")),
        "match_score": score,
        "match_tier": tier(score),
        "score_breakdown": breakdown,
        "match_percentages": pcts,
        "skills": {
            "required": [pretty(s) for s in required],
            "matched": [pretty(s) for s in matched],
            "missing": [pretty(s) for s in missing],
            "required_count": len(required),
            "matched_count": len(matched),
            "missing_count": len(missing),
            "match_percentage": pcts["skills"],
        },
        "experience": {
            "candidate_years": candidate_years,
            "experience_assumed": candidate_years is None,
            "required_years": rmin,
            "required_max_years": rmax,
            "required_source": rsrc,
            "match_percentage": pcts["experience"],
        },
        "location_match": loc_label,
        "job_type_match": jt_label,
        "education_match": edu_label,
        "education_detail": edu_detail,
        "match_summary": "",
        "data_quality": dq,
        "matching_debug": {
            "resume_available": P.get("available"),
            "candidate_skills": P.get("skills", []),
            "candidate_skill_count": len(P.get("skills", [])),
            "skill_source": P.get("skill_source"),
            "resume_keys": P.get("resume_keys", []),
            "target_roles": P.get("targets", []),
            "candidate_experience_years": P.get("experience_years"),
            "candidate_experience_known": P.get("experience_known"),
            "required_skills": required,
            "matched_skills": matched,
            "missing_skills": missing,
        },
        "engine_version": ENGINE_VERSION,
    }
    result["match_summary"] = build_summary(result)
    return result

# RANK & SELECT TOP 5 (compact) - n8n Python Code node, "Run Once for All Items", no imports.
TOP_N = 5
num = lambda v: v if isinstance(v, (int, float)) else 0
dct = lambda v: v if isinstance(v, dict) else {}

rows = [dict(i["json"]) for i in _items if isinstance(i["json"], dict)]
rows = [r for r in rows if str(r.get("job_title") or "").strip() and not dct(r.get("data_quality")).get("scoring_error")]

def key(r):  # best first: score, skills %, fewer missing skills, title %, title A-Z, job_id (final tie-break)
    return (-num(r.get("match_score")), -num(dct(r.get("match_percentages")).get("skills")),
            num(dct(r.get("skills")).get("missing_count")), -num(dct(r.get("match_percentages")).get("job_title")),
            str(r["job_title"]).lower(), str(r.get("job_id") or r.get("job_url") or ""))

seen, ranked = set(), []
for r in sorted(rows, key=key):
    d = r.get("job_id") or r.get("job_url") or (r.get("company"), r["job_title"], r.get("location"))
    if d not in seen:  # same job scraped twice -> keep the best copy
        seen.add(d)
        ranked.append(r)

avg = round(sum(num(r.get("match_score")) for r in ranked) / len(ranked), 1) if ranked else 0
return [{"json": dict(r, rank=n + 1, total_jobs_ranked=len(ranked), pool_avg_score=avg)} for n, r in enumerate(ranked[:TOP_N])]
